buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of IPGCL payable at NEW DELHI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of IPGCL payable at NEW DELHI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses BIDDERS ARE REQUESTED TO PROVIDE DETAILS IN THE ATTACHED FORMAT AND SUBMIT ONLY NECESSARY DOCUMENTS AS REQUIRED IN BID AND ATTACHED FOR MAT IN 'BUYER UPLOADED ATC DOCUMENT' ABOVE. QUALIFYING CRITERIA FOR BIDDERS- 1.The average annual financial turnover of the bidder for the last three financial years ending 31st March, 2026 (or the latest available audited financial year) shall be at least 30% of the estimated value inclusive o f GST, i.e. ₹22 Lakh (rounded off, as GeM permits only rounded figures for turnover criteria). The bidder sh all upload audited financial statements (Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account) for the preceding three fi nancial years, duly certified by a Chartered Accountant and bearing a valid Unique Document Identificatio n Number (UDIN), as part of the bid submission. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the documents sub mitted by the bidder. 2.The bidder should have successfully executed similar works of Hiring of Electric Sedans to Central Govt. / State Govt. / Public Sector Organization / Listed Companies during the last seven years ending last day of t he previous month in which NIT is published, with any of the following experience: a. Three executed orders each costing not less than Rs. 29.62 Lakh (i.e. 40% of estimated value inclusive of GST): OR b. Two executed orders each costing not less than Rs. 37.02 Lakh (i.e. 50% of estimated value inclusive of GST): OR c. One executed order costing not less than Rs. 59.24 Lakh (i.e. 80% of estimated value inclusive of GST). Copies of work orders indicating the order value inclusive of GST @ 5%, along with completion certificates / performance certificates towards satisfactory execution of the work, shall be uploaded with the bid. Wher e GST is shown separately, the bidder shall submit supporting documents establishing the total order value inclusive of GST. IPGCL reserves the right to verify the documents from the issuing authority. 3.Turnover and experience criteria shall not be mandatory for Start-ups (DIPP registered vendors) and MSE registered vendors, in terms of GeM guidelines, subject to submission of valid registration certificates. 4. The bidder must be registered with EPF and ESI authorities. Valid registration certificates along with latest return / challan shall be uploaded as part of bid submission. IPGCL will verify the documents submitt ed by the bidder. 5. The registered office of the bidder should be located in Delhi/NCR of Delhi. 6. The bidder must own at least 06 (Six) nos. electric sedans in the name of the firm. The bidder shall upl oad copies of Registration Certificates (RCs) of these sedans along with the bid documents. . 7. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW)

Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK(FOR VENDORS)- As per GeM SLA and packages. SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (FOR VENDORS) 1. THESE ELECTRIC SEDANS VEHICLES ARE BEING HIRED FOR THE POWER GENERATION COMPANY AND T HE SERVICES MAY ALSO BE REQUIRED IN WEEKLY OFF DAYS OR HOLIDAYS. 2. THESE VEHICLES CAN BE DIVERTED TO ANY OTHER LOCATION OF DELHI AS PER THE REQUIREMENT AT ANY POINT OF TIME DURING THE CONTRATUAL PERIOD. 3. IPGCL/PPCL SHALL HAVE THE AUTHORITY TO REDUCE THE VEHICLES AT ANY POINT OF THE TIME DURIN G THE CONTRACT PERIOD, WITH 15 DAY NOTICE TO THE VENDOR AND THE PAYMENT WILL BE DONE AS P ER THE ACTUAL DEPLOYMENT ON PRO-RATA BASIS. 4. THE VENDOR SHALL MAINTAIN LOG SHEETS MANUALLY AND GET IT SIGNED BY THE USERS ON DAILY B ASIS. SEPARATE MONTHLY BILLS FOR EACH VEHICLE WILL BE RAISED BY THE VENDOR. THE LOG SHEETS DULY SIGNED AND VERIFIED BY THE USERS ARE REQUIRED TO BE SUBMITTED TO GAD SECTION ON REGU LAR BASIS. 5. THE INVOICE WILL BE RAISED BY THE VENDOR ON THE BASIS OF JOURNEY VERIFIED BY USERS AND SU BMIT TO THE GAD SECTION FOR PAYMENT. 6. THE VENDORS SHOULD HAVE ESI AND EPF REGISTRATION AND A COPY OF THE REGISTRATION CERTIFI CATES (NO OTHER DOCUMENT IS ADMISSIBLE) SHOULD INVARIABLY BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH BID. 7. GPS TRACKING SYSTEM SHOULD BE INSTALLED IN THE VEHICLE AND A CERTIFICATE TO THIS EFFECT S HOULD BE SUBMITTED WHILE EXECUTING THE CONTRACT. 8. THE REGD ADDRESS OF THE VENDOR SHOULD BE IN DELHI/NCR. 9.a) Type of Vehicle : Tata Tigor EV, Tata Nexon EV, Maruti Suzuki E Vitara Delta b) Package : 2400KMS X 300 HOURS c) Color of Vehicle : White d) Model : 2023, 2024, 2025 & 2026 Contract Agreement : Not Applicable Indemnity Bond : Not Applicable SD (e-PBG):- Applicable PBG:-Applicable SPECIAL NOTE 1. The vendors are advised to quote UNIT RATES only in BOQ ( Bill of Qty.) of the NIT. In case of incomplet e/vague information regarding the same, the quoted rate will be taken as UNIT RATE only and PPCL will not be held responsible for the same in any way.

2. The quoted rates in the BOQ should be inclusive of EPF, ESI and BONUS etc. 3.BOQ for price:- The seller/bidder are advised that BOQ should not be attached with Techno commercial bid document otherwise the bid will be outrightly rejected. It is two-part bidding case. 4. TDS will be deducted as per the provision of the income tax Act. 5. The exemption from Earnest Money deposit (EMD) shall be extended only to those MSME vendors who are registered under the Service/ Manufacturer/ Trader Category as Micro or Small Enterprises (MSEs) and whose Udyam Registration covers the relevant product/activity as per tender’s scope of work. 6. THE VALIDITY OF THE OFFER AND DETAILS OF EMD SHOULD BE CLEARLY MENTIONED ON THE FACE OF THE EMD ENVELOPE. Pl submit SAC/HSN Code_____________ Note:- In case vendor do not mention the rate of GST then it will be treated as extra and quoted price will be processed considering applicable GST. 7. Common IP address: Bidders may please note that received bids having matching /common IP address with either bidders/seller s or buyer shall be out rightly rejected and shall not be considered for further evaluation.
